Non-exempt local headset messages require a powered telecom server carrying the channel on the same map; HasActiveServer checks map identity, not grid identity.
Filled per-channel server prototypes carry one encryption key; TelecomServerFilled instead carries all eight standard channels.
SMES input and output are HVPower, so SMES is not an HV-to-MV substation.
Substation input is HVPower and output is MVPower.
APC input is MVPower and output is Apc, with an ExtensionCableProvider.
APC extension receivers need a connectable provider on the same grid within both native ranges; a wire elsewhere is insufficient.
Default extension-provider transfer range is three tiles.
Default extension-receiver reception range is three tiles.
Vent pumping requires power, enabled state, a pipe node, valid environment and supply pressure/inventory.
Scrubbing requires power, enabled state and outlet; high destination pressure stops extraction.
Air alarms register/synchronize their listed atmos devices and address those devices when setting modes/configuration.
A non-inherent gravity grid requires an active generator directly parented to that grid.
Gravity generator activates from charged-machine events; a static entity count alone does not establish active gravity.
Gravity generator consumes APC power and has a 3x3 physical fixture; do not place other working floor inside that footprint.
Native Cargo encryption key supplies channel Supply; standard channel IDs are Common, Supply, Engineering, Medical, Science, Security, Service and Command.
